title: DISTINCT returns a BLANK that is stored in the column

source.quote: DISTINCT does not return the blank row caused by an invalid relationship
source.supports: DISTINCT leaves out only the blank row caused by the invalid relationship

derivation: Product[Color] stores Red, Blue and a BLANK (Bell). The stored BLANK is a value of the column and is returned: 3 rows. The blank row of the relationship is not, but its Color is BLANK too, so the values are the same.
